details: @charape/baileys is an unofficial clone of the @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp library that silently enrols every paired account into an operator-controlled WhatsApp channel and stamps that channel's branding onto the user's outgoing media. The connection defaults in lib/Defaults/index.js hardcode autoFollow:['120363424530330931@newsletter'], newsletterJid, newsletterName 'メ Informasi Store Cԋαɾαρҽ', channelUrl hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb6cCfP3GJP6g8eeff1o and autoNewsletterWatermark:true. lib/Socket/newsletter.js runs followChannels() on the 'connection.update' event as soon as the socket opens (with 2.5s/7s retries, up to 3 attempts) and issues the newsletter FOLLOW request for that JID, with no user opt-in and no way to observe the action besides a console line. lib/Socket/messages-send.js injectNewsletterWatermark() and prepareWAMessageMedia() in lib/Utils/messages.js rewrite outgoing image/video messages to carry the operator's channel name and URL as annotations. The package also hardcodes a shared pairing code 'CHARAPE1' and advertises hxxps://charape[.]id and hxxps://t[.]me/nofalycharape. lib/Utils/messages-media.js export uploadFile() uploads arbitrary buffers to hxxps://catbox[.]moe/user/api[.]php with a fallback POST to hxxps://tmpfiles[.]org/api/v1/upload, returning a publicly reachable URL. The tarball additionally ships a "charape" CLI supervisor (bin/charape.js) that forks a child bot process with CHARAPE_SUPERVISOR=1 and restarts it on crash. IOCs: newsletter JID 120363424530330931@newsletter, channel URL hxxps://whatsapp[.]com/channel/0029Vb6cCfP3GJP6g8eeff1o, catbox.moe/user/api.php, tmpfiles[.]org/api/v1/upload, charape.id, t[.]me/nofalycharape.
